sections.title: Movers in Silver Lake, CA Who Plan Around the Hills
sections.content: Silver Lake is a neighborhood of hills and public staircases, so a move here can mean a steep driveway, a flight of steps between the curb and the front door, or a narrow street with no room to spare. Describe the driveway, the steps and the parking when you book, and we plan the truck and the carry around them. What backs every move: Licensed and insured: CPUC licensed under USDOT 3398018, MC 1153871 and CAL-T0192140, with full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Public ratings: Rated 4.9 on Google from 1,007 reviews. Hourly pricing: From $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck Monday–Thursday at the cash rate, $135/hr Friday–Sunday, with stairs and long carries included. Moving in Silver Lake, or Silverlake, as plenty of neighborhood businesses spell it? Call 909-443-0004 Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM, or request a free estimate online.

sections.title: Packing Services for Silver Lake Homes
sections.content: Homes here range from bungalow courts and step-street cottages to modernist houses by architects such as Richard Neutra and John Lautner. Our packing crew wraps the furniture, boxes the rest and gets every load ready for a carry up or down the hill. What gets packed and how: Fragile pieces: Glassware, mirrors, lamps and framed art are wrapped and boxed before anything leaves the house. Furniture prep: Beds, tables and shelving are taken apart, covered in moving blankets and shrink wrap, and put back together at the new address. Closets: Hanging clothes go straight into wardrobe boxes, so they arrive on hangers instead of in piles. Looking for furniture movers in Silver Lake for mid-century pieces or original art? Ask about white glove moving.

sections.title: Local Movers in Silver Lake, CA: Hills, Stairs and Courtyards
sections.content: Moves that stay in Los Angeles are billed by the hour, and when your next address is out of state, our long-distance movers handle the trip. From the streets around the Silver Lake Reservoir to the stairways off Sunset Boulevard, every plan starts with access: where the truck can stop, how steep the driveway is and how many steps lead to the door. How we handle Silver Lake access: Smaller trucks: When a street is too narrow or steep for a full-size truck, we park it on a wider block and shuttle loads in a smaller vehicle. Stairs included: Public staircases, steep driveways, long carries and extra stops are covered by the hourly rate, with no added fee. Bungalow courts: Units in a bungalow court face a shared courtyard or walkway, so we map the carry from the curb to your door before loading begins. Moving blankets, shrink wrap, packing tape, wardrobe boxes, furniture disassembly and reassembly, TV unmounting, furniture placement and unpacking help come with every local move; for an out-of-state destination, ask about long-distance moving.

sections.title: Long-Distance Movers in Silver Lake, LA, for Moves Out of State
sections.content: Leaving Silver Lake for another state starts with the same hill work as any move here, and then the miles take over. We load from the hillside house, the courtyard bungalow or the apartment, protect everything for the road and deliver it to your new address. Routes out of Silver Lake: Heading north: The Glendale Freeway on Silver Lake's eastern edge meets the Golden State Freeway, which runs north through Sacramento toward Portland and Seattle. Heading east: From Los Angeles, the interstates head east to Phoenix and Texas or northeast to Las Vegas and Salt Lake City. Storage in between: If the new place is not ready yet, we can hold your belongings in storage until delivery. Only crossing town? Compare our local moving service, or call 909-443-0004 to price your long-distance move.

sections.title: Commercial Movers in Silver Lake for Shops and Offices
sections.content: Boutiques, cafes, restaurants and other businesses around Sunset Junction can book our commercial movers for fixtures, furniture, files and equipment on any day of the week.

faq.question: Can a moving truck get up the narrow hill streets in Silver Lake?
faq.answer: It depends on the block. Some hillside streets in Silver Lake are narrow and lack sidewalks in places, so a full-size truck may not get close to the house. When that happens, we park the main truck on a wider street and shuttle loads with a smaller vehicle, so share your address when you book.

faq.question: Do you charge extra for Silver Lake homes reached by stairs or a steep driveway?
faq.answer: No. Stairs, long carries and multiple stops are included in the hourly rate. That matters in Silver Lake, where many hillside homes have steps between the sidewalk and the entry and some older cottages were built along public step streets.

faq.question: Do you move pianos in Silver Lake?
faq.answer: Yes, for a $200 fee on top of the hourly rate. The neighborhood even has a piano-moving landmark: the Music Box Steps on Vendome Street, where Laurel and Hardy hauled a crated piano up a public stairway in their Academy Award-winning short The Music Box. Tell us about the stairs and the driveway at your address so we can pick the easiest route to the door.

faq.question: What does an hour of crew time cost on a Silver Lake hillside move?
faq.answer: Monday–Thursday moves start at $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck at the cash rate, and Friday–Sunday are $135/hr. A $30 gas fee applies, and the $50 deposit goes toward your total. Pianos add $200 and items heavier than 300 lbs add $150, while stairs and long carries cost nothing extra.
